root_causes: Several articles used an empty .image div whose artwork existed only as a CSS background.
CSS background images do not expose an image-element error event, so a bad or missing URL left an empty black image well.
Legacy .descendant-panel rules introduced alternate padding, borders, heights, and mobile geometry.
Some articles used a kicker, no top line, or a differently classified parent section instead of Eternal Dragon’s canonical structure.
permanent_fixes: Every Design Echo image is now a real img.inline-image-media element.
Every image uses an art_crop primary URL, exact-card normal fallback, fuzzy art_crop fallback, and readable final failure state.
Every copy field uses div.eyebrow, h3, and explanatory paragraph content.
All .descendant-panel elements and CSS rules were removed.
The template, schema, canonical contract, generation prompt, migration tools, validator, shared CSS/JS, and GitHub workflow enforce the component.
mechanical_audit: A=1, B=407, with no new mechanical issue signatures introduced
